contact.faqs_subtitle: Check common answers regarding purchases, shipping, and guarantees on TapTrade.

faq_list.q1: How long does my order take to arrive?
faq_list.a1: Shipments are handled via Chilexpress and Starken within an estimated 24 to 48 business hours after dispatch. If you chose store pickup ($0), you will receive a notification when ready.
faq_list.q2: How does the Escrow Guarantee & Custody work?
faq_list.a2: Your payment is held 100% securely on the platform and only released to the seller once tracking is submitted and you confirm satisfactory receipt of your cards.
faq_list.q3: What do I do if a card does not match the listed condition?
faq_list.a3: All TapTrade stores are required to grade per official standard (NM, LP, MP, HP, DMG). If you receive something different, open a mediation ticket in your panel or contact support@taptrade.cl.
faq_list.q4: How can I open a store and sell on TapTrade?
faq_list.a4: We provide a SaaS platform with 0% commission on your card sales. You just need to register as a store, configure payout details, and sync your inventory.
